there are lots of notes about programming and specifically the seperation of data and data strucutre from implementation code. Search the notes to find the best practices and then upgrade this prompt. 

<pasted_content id="b9b6">
Act as an expert Infrastructure as Code (IaC) architect. We are adopting a strictly data-centric approach to our Terraform architecture, requiring a clean separation between configuration data and implementation logic. 

Use the 1mcp coding tools to review the @azure/ad Terraform modules and provide a structured analysis based on the following criteria:

1. Data vs. Logic Separation: Scan the modules and explicitly identify what constitutes configuration data versus structural implementation code.
2. Data Modelling & Typology: Define exactly what data exists, categorise the different types of data, and map how it is currently modelled.
3. Structure & Accessibility: Evaluate if the current data is well-structured, human-readable, and easily accessible (e.g., standard .tfvars, YAML, or JSON formats).
4. Anti-Pattern Detection: Highlight specific lines or files where data and implementation code are improperly merged, hardcoded, or tightly coupled.

Conclude with a summary of recommended refactoring steps to extract the identified data into a clean, data-driven structure.
</pasted_content id="b9b6">

cmd: cd /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/30_Library; wc -c "SoT/SoT - The Data-Centric Philosophy.md" "SoT/SoT - Data-Oriented Design.md" "MoC/MOC - Data-Oriented Structures & Internals.md" "100_zettelkasten/Smart Data Structures Yield Trivial Code (Torvalds' Maxim, Corrected Sourcing).md" "100_zettelkasten/Jackson Structured Programming - Control Flow Should Be Isomorphic to Data Structure.md"; cat "SoT/SoT - The Data-Centric Philosophy.md" | head -150; rg -il "terraform|tfvars|infrastructure as code|declarative config|data-driven|rules of representation|Rob Pike|make illegal states" . | head -30

cd /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon; wc -c "30_Library/200_Projects/Additions to the Data-First Customer IaC Plan.md" "30_Library/200_Projects/CUE-ASSESSMENT.md"; ls 30_Library/MoC | rg -i "data-centric|type|iac|infra"; ls 30_Library/SoT | rg -i "parse|simple|type-driven|structure is truth|hickey|schema|declarative|cue"; ls 30_Library/100_zettelkasten | rg -i "data-first|data-driven|schema|parse|illegal|table|config|declarative" | head -40

cd /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/30_Library; for f in "SoT/SoT - Type-Driven Infrastructure Strategy.md" "SoT/SoT - Pattern - CUE Data Architecture.md" "MoC/MOC - Data-Centric Infrastructure.md" "100_zettelkasten/Cloud Configurations as Ad-hoc DSLs.md" "100_zettelkasten/Over Half of Customer Configuration Lines Are Exact Duplicates.md" "100_zettelkasten/CI Pipeline Validates Nothing About Customer Configuration Changes.md" "100_zettelkasten/Parse, Don't Validate - Validation Is Lossy, Parsing Is Constructive.md" "100_zettelkasten/A Hand-Written Helm Schema Is a Cheaper Partial Alternative to CUE.md"; do echo "=== $f"; sed -e '1,/^---$/{/^---$/!d}' "$f" | awk 'BEGIN{c=0} /^---$/{c++; next} c>=2' | head -70 | cut -c1-600; done

cd /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/30_Library; for f in "SoT/SoT - Type-Driven Infrastructure Strategy.md" "SoT/SoT - Pattern - CUE Data Architecture.md" "MoC/MOC - Data-Centric Infrastructure.md" "100_zettelkasten/Cloud Configurations as Ad-hoc DSLs.md" "100_zettelkasten/Over Half of Customer Configuration Lines Are Exact Duplicates.md" "100_zettelkasten/CI Pipeline Validates Nothing About Customer Configuration Changes.md" "100_zettelkasten/Parse, Don't Validate - Validation Is Lossy, Parsing Is Constructive.md"; do echo "=== $f"; awk '/^---$/{c++; next} c>=2' "$f" | head -60 | cut -c1-500; done
